# MAW waveform source

Imported from the user-supplied MAW Windows x64 v1.10.0-beta.2 distribution.
The waveform modules, gap algorithms, marker utilities, and styles retain their
original implementation. Host layout is supplied by Substar. The adapter lives
outside this directory. Local modifications: scoped CSS; host layout seam in
waveform.js. No external service or MAW project storage is used.

ASS panel: original ass-style-window template and ass-animation.js from the same MAW distribution. Host adapter editor_maw_ass.js connects styles, profiles and animations to Substar revision configuration, export and libass preview. MASS inline syntax and the separate SRT toolbox are outside this panel.
